name: Hover Note
description: A rich floating card that appears beside a word in running text and follows the pointer, leaning slightly as it moves.

props.name: content
props.description: What the floating card shows. It is a w-72 popover surface with p-3 padding.

props.name: children
props.description: The inline text that opens the card. It gets a dotted underline and is focusable; on keyboard focus the card sits under it instead of following the pointer, and Escape closes it.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the floating card, for example to change its padding or width.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the inline trigger.
